func t1(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_unbound expect=pass
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> { await save(item) }
  }
}
func t2(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_bound_capture expect=pass
  for item in items {
    let task = _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> { [item] in await save(item) }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}
func t3(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_handle_awaited expect=fire
  for item in items {
    let task = _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> { await save(item) }
    await task.value
  }
}
func t4(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_priority expect=pass
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never>(priority: .background) { await save(item) }
  }
}
func t5(items: [Int]) async throws {
  // CASE qualified_generic_throwing_value expect=fire
  for item in items {
    let value = try await _Concurrency.Task<Int, Error> { try await load(item) }.value
    use(value)
  }
}
func t6(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE unqualified_generic_priority expect=pass
  for item in items {
    Task<Void, Never>(priority: .utility) { await save(item) }
  }
}
func t7(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_await_after expect=fire
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> { await save(item) }
    await log(item)
  }
}
func t8(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE qualified_generic_nested_loop expect=fire
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> {
      for part in item.parts {
        await save(part)
      }
    }
  }
}
func t9(items: [Int]) async {
  // CASE plain_loop expect=fire
  for item in items {
    await save(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_inorder expect=pass
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], reason: String, _ step: (T) async throws -> Void) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    try await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_inorder_impostor expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], reason: String, _ step: (T) async throws -> Void) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    try await step(item)
    await log(item)
  }
}
